reviewer_provenance.review_type: assistant review, not independent human benchmark
reviewer_provenance.unit: one assistant reply per exchange in one continuous rolling-context chat

percentile_method.definition: linear interpolation on sorted explicit totals
percentile_method.formula: position = (n - 1) * q, n = 100; value = lower + fractional(position) * (upper - lower)
percentile_method.interpretation: higher is better; P95/P99 describe the best-scoring tail, not the worst tail

limitations: Scores are explicit reviewer judgments, not heuristic classifications and not a human benchmark.
Review used only the user prompt, external support, and complete retained recent pairs recorded for each generation.
Older facts omitted by the rolling window were not treated as available; ignoring supplied facts was penalized.
Generation cutoff was noted only when relevant and was not an automatic penalty.
